module: Career tutorial step 8 ("driveToGarage"): the player drives to the garage, parks in the garageExteriorPark spot (stationary 1 s, within 25 m to trigger the parking phase), then gets out of the vehicle (walking mode). Phases: driveToGarage, parkAtGarage, hopOut, waitArrivalPopups. Two arrival popups (v2/garageArrivalIntro1 and 2) conclude the step, then the guidance leads to the garageInteriorWalkStart point.
notes: Three zones driveToGarageZone1 to 3 serve as respawn points: when leaving the zone, the vehicle is put back on the driveToGarageReset<N> spot of the last checkpoint reached.
If no respawn zone exists in the tutorial sites, the active zones are cleared and no reset is installed.
Once parked: engine off, vehicle frozen and blacklisted for walking (player cannot get back in), damage tracking disabled on exit.
At the start of the step, any drag race is stopped (gameplay_drag_dragBridge.stopDragRace).

setup.desc: Called on activation: stops the drag, finds the player vehicle, the garage spots and zones, installs zones and reset, allows walking and entering the vehicle, creates the marker and displays the objective.

onCareerTutorialLeftBounds.desc: Out-of-bounds hook: starts the step's out-of-bounds reset.

onIntroPopupCareerClosed.desc: Popup close hook: when v2/garageArrivalIntro2 closes (waitArrivalPopups phase), draws the route to the garage interior and schedules the step advance after 1 s.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: updates the respawn checkpoint, handles the driving / parking / exiting the vehicle phases.

cleanup.desc: Removes the zone reset, unlocks walking, clears the tasks and deletes the parking visuals.

onDebugMenu.desc: Displays the phase and a "Skip Step 8" button (teleports to the garage, switches to walking mode, advances).
